scenarios.name: Stage a separator from a category with no macro commands

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools target
the Macros category has no macro commands available in this session
the user selects the Macros command category
the custom panel list remains empty
the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available list
a separator appears in the custom panel list
the target is marked as changed
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
